item.title: Nishi Izu Wild Coast: Sunset Cliffs and Roadside Onsen — Guide
item.description: Nishi Izu, the western shore of the Izu Peninsula, is the peninsula’s wildest and least developed coast, a winding stretch of volcanic cliffs, fishing villages and coves largely untouched by big resort development because no railway reaches it. The reward for making the drive is some of Japan’s finest coastal scenery: sunsets over the sea considered among the country’s best, and unpretentious roadside and cliff-top onsen where you can soak in the open air with views across Suruga Bay to Mount Fuji.
